sourceDescription: Heiberg, Archimedis Opera Omnia cum commentariis Eutocii, 1st ed., vol. 2 (Teubner, 1880/81)

archimedes-sand-reckoner-ch-1.source: Heiberg, Archimedis opera omnia (1st ed.) vol. II, p. 256, leaf 294

markers.note: Diagram for the geometric construction bounding the sun's angular diameter (circle ΑΒΓ = cosmos, ΔΕΖ = earth, ΣΗ = sun, centre Θ/Κ, sighting lines from eye Δ tangent to the sun's circle). This is the construction that follows the earlier textual description (pp. 251-253, leaves 287-289) of the rod-and-cylinder sighting apparatus itself, which prints no diagram of its own - only this later lettered figure is illustrated in the source.
